name: folio
description: Folio — a quiet archive that keeps long chats light.

shortenOutputs.title: Shorten long shell outputs
shortenOutputs.description: A shell command's output over 20,000 characters reaches Claude as its start, its end and a note. Folio saves the whole output first, and recall gives back any of it word for word. A command that only prints files, and any output inside a subagent, stays whole. On by default; turn it off to keep every output whole in the chat.

promptPointers.title: Point Claude to folded parts
promptPointers.description: When a prompt or a subagent's brief names a file, an id such as A29, or a task that only folded parts hold, Folio adds one line for Claude: "Folded parts that mention A29: 77, 79, 96." No model call, about 30 tokens, and only when something matches. On by default; turn it off to add nothing to prompts.

projectLayout.title: Keep project folders organised
projectLayout.description: Folio gives Claude a short rule for laying out a project's folders, shaped to the way you work and keeping one order: a README at the top, a few top-level folders named as you name things, what you make kept apart by stage (drafts apart from deliveries) and by piece with every version logged, sorted References, and Work for everything else (Work/Backup and a folder for each tool), folder names starting with a capital letter. For video work that is Animations, Renders/Drafts and Renders/Final by animation, Segments by animation and Work/Scripts, which FolioPack's list reads as clean groups. Claude offers to tidy a project that has drifted, or to change the layout when the way you work changes, and moves files only on your yes. A layout rule the project already has comes first, and a code repository keeps its own. About 550 tokens, sent at the start and after each compaction. On by default; turn it off to send nothing.

projectPlaces.title: Tell Claude where this project keeps its files
projectPlaces.description: Once per chat, Folio reads where the project already keeps each kind of file (renders, editing projects, references, sound) and tells Claude. With Keep project folders organised on, that rule comes first: this note fills in where a project doesn't follow it yet or the rule names no place, and Claude moves files only as the rule says, on your yes. With that rule off, Claude saves new files where their kind already lives and never moves one. A project with no clear layout gets no note. On by default; turn it off to leave file places to Claude.

projectCopies.title: Keep a copy of each chat in its project
projectCopies.description: In a project with a Work folder at its top, Folio writes a copy of its files for each chat into the project: the summaries, part cards, tasks and ledger in Work/Folio/<chat>, and the word-for-word archive and the chat's log in Work/Backup/Folio/<chat>. Folio never makes the Work folder itself. It still reads its own store in ~/.claude/folio, so recall keeps working when the project is moved or its drive is away. The private file is never copied; every other file already holds a placeholder for each private value. Never in the home folder or a code repository. FolioPack leaves these folders out, since it packs the chats itself. On by default; turn it off to stop writing copies (the ones written stay).

foldNote.title: Ask Claude for a note before a fold
foldNote.description: Before Automatic folds while the prompt cache is still warm, Folio asks Claude itself what is still open, what it is in the middle of, and what in the parts about to fold it needs word for word. The answer closes finished open tasks, writes the map's State now, and can hold a part back from that fold. It costs about one ordinary request a fold, and a fold waits at most 30 seconds for it. Never on a cold fold or Claude Code's own compaction. Off by default until it has been tried in the app.

tasksPlace.title: Where the list of tasks sits
tasksPlace.description: Under the chat strip, in the chat's own box, or in a box of its own just after it.
options: In a box of their own

footerPlace.title: Where FolioPack sits
footerPlace.description: Pinned to the bottom of the panel under a thin rule (the default), or right after the last box.
